recognized_test_commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail; npm test 2>&1 | sed -n '/"'^[[:space:]]*[0-9][0-9]* passing /p;/''^[[:space:]]*[0-9][0-9]* failing /p;/''^  [0-9][0-9]*) /p;/''^Error:/p'"'; printf 'test_exit=%s\\n' \""'${PIPESTATUS[0]}"'
/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail; npm test 2>&1 | awk '/"'^  1'"\\) \"before all\"/{capture=1} capture {print}'; printf 'test_exit=%s\\n' \""'${PIPESTATUS[0]}"'

/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail; npm test 2>&1 | awk '/"'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+ passing / || /''^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+ failing / || /''^  [0-9]+'"\\) / || /"'^     (Error|AssertionError|TypeError):/ {print}'"'; printf 'test_exit=%s\\n' \""'${PIPESTATUS[0]}"'
/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail; npm test 2>&1 | awk '/"'^  1'"\\) Admin Controllers/{capture=1} capture && "'!/''^======/{print}'"'; printf 'test_exit=%s\\n' \""'${PIPESTATUS[0]}"'

/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail; ./node_modules/.bin/mocha test/user.js test/user/emails.js --reporter dot 2>&1 | awk '/"'^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+ passing / || /''^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+ failing / || /''^  [0-9]+'"\\) / || /"'^     (Error|AssertionError|TypeError):/ {print}'"'; printf 'test_exit=%s\\n' \""'${PIPESTATUS[0]}"'

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
